speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Where does it pain you tonight, Will?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the head. There's a city in it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then go and write the city, and leave the king with me. I have the glass.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Nine. He said he would rise at nine. He has risen. Let the man have his street.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The song is done. I am not adding a verse to keep him.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The slate stays forgiven. Do not make me a story on the way home.
